faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Lake Errock?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 12 houses listed in Lake Errock. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Lake Errock a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: Lake Errock houses sold at a sales ratio of 8% in October 2026, a buyers’ market on the reports’ scale (under 12% favours buyers, over 20% favours sellers).

faq.q: How many houses sold in Lake Errock from June to October 2026?
faq.a: Between June and October 2026, 5 houses sold in Lake Errock; Mission as a whole recorded 141.

faq.q: What did houses in Lake Errock sell for?
faq.a: 11 houses sold in Lake Errock from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, at a median price of $865,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Lake Errock?
faq.a: Half sold in 102 days or less, at a median 95.3% of the last list price; 0% went over asking (sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026).
